note: UI text for S01. Flat i18n keys, one entry per key, with zh_TW and en. Placeholders use {name}. S02 maps them to Qt id-based translations and converts {name} to %1 or %n. Where the text gives the user a next step, the key name contains 'advice' or 'action'.

ui.empty.body.zh_TW: 開啟一張板子影像，再框選一個樣本元件。程式會找出其餘相似的元件。
ui.empty.body.en: Open a board image. Then draw a box around one sample part. The program finds the similar parts.

ui.empty.hint.drop.zh_TW: 也可以把影像檔拖進這個視窗。
ui.empty.hint.drop.en: You can also drop an image file on this window.

ui.idle.hint.zh_TW: S 在一個元件上框一個樣本 · 再按 F5 搜尋 · R 框選區域，用樣本庫找出元件
ui.idle.hint.en: S draws a sample on one part · then F5 searches · R scans a region with the library

ui.sample.hint.zh_TW: 放開滑鼠建立樣本（不搜尋） · Esc 取消
ui.sample.hint.en: Release to create the sample (no search yet) · Esc to cancel

ui.sample.tooSmall.en: The sample is too small (minimum {min} px)

ui.preview.summary.zh_TW: 找到 {found} 個 · 推算 {inferred} 個 · 拒絕 {rejected} 個

ui.preview.hint.zh_TW: Enter 接受 · Esc 捨棄 · Del 刪除所選
ui.preview.hint.en: Enter to accept · Esc to discard · Del to delete the selection

ui.preview.lowConfidence.zh_TW: {count} 個框的信心偏低，建議檢查。
ui.preview.lowConfidence.en: {count} boxes have low confidence. Check them.

ui.preview.accepted.zh_TW: 已接受 {count} 個框 · Ctrl+Z 復原

ui.preview.discarded.zh_TW: 已捨棄提案 · Ctrl+Z 復原

ui.preview.merged.zh_TW: {count} 個位置被不只一個樣本找到，只留分數最高的。
ui.preview.merged.en: {count} positions were found by more than one sample. Only the best score stays.

ui.preview.excluded.zh_TW: {count} 個位置已有手動補的元件，不列入。
ui.preview.excluded.en: {count} positions already hold a manual part. They are left out.

ui.preview.replaces.zh_TW: 接受時，上一次自動產生的 {count} 個元件會換成這一次的結果。
ui.preview.replaces.en: Accept replaces the {count} parts from the last search with this result.

ui.preview.offLattice.zh_TW: {count} 個不在陣列的格點上（單獨的元件或偏離陣列），位置是匹配到的。
ui.preview.offLattice.en: {count} parts are not on an array node (alone or off the array). Their positions come from the match.

ui.sample.added.zh_TW: 已建立樣本 {name} · 板上有 {count} 個樣本 · F5 搜尋
ui.sample.added.en: Sample {name} created · {count} samples on the board · F5 to search

ui.sample.hintIdle.zh_TW: F5 搜尋（{count} 個樣本） · S 再建立一個樣本 · B 在所選元件上畫框 · 拖把手改大小
ui.sample.hintIdle.en: F5 to search ({count} samples) · S to add a sample · B to draw a box on the selected part · drag a handle to resize

ui.search.noSamples.zh_TW: 還沒有樣本：先用 S 在一個元件上框一個樣本。
ui.search.noSamples.en: There is no sample yet. Draw one on a part with S first.

ui.box.hint.zh_TW: 在所選的元件上框一個子框 · 放開後同類型的元件都會多出這個框 · Esc 取消
ui.box.hint.en: Draw a box on the selected part · every part of that type gets it · Esc to cancel

ui.box.needOne.zh_TW: 先選取一個元件，再在它上面畫子框。
ui.box.needOne.en: Select one part first, then draw the box on it.

ui.box.added.zh_TW: 已加上子框：同類型的 {count} 個元件一起更新 · Ctrl+Z 復原
ui.box.added.en: Box added: {count} parts of this type updated · Ctrl+Z to undo

ui.resize.applied.zh_TW: 已改大小：同類型的 {count} 個元件一起更新 · Ctrl+Z 復原
ui.resize.applied.en: Resized: {count} parts of this type updated · Ctrl+Z to undo

ui.history.resizeType.zh_TW: 改 {count} 個元件的框大小

ui.history.addBoxGroup.zh_TW: 在 {count} 個元件上加子框

tool.box.zh_TW: 畫子框：在所選的元件上框一個框，同類型一起更新
tool.box.en: Draw box: add a box to the selected part and every part of its type

ui.noMatch.body.zh_TW: 程式找不到與樣本相似的元件。請試試下列做法：
ui.noMatch.body.en: The program found no part that looks like the sample. Try one of these:

ui.noMatch.advice.sampleTooSmall.zh_TW: 樣本太小：把框拉大，包含元件的完整外形。
ui.noMatch.advice.sampleTooSmall.en: The sample is too small. Make the box larger so it holds the whole part.

ui.noMatch.advice.sampleTooLarge.zh_TW: 樣本比元件大很多：把框縮到元件的外形。
ui.noMatch.advice.sampleTooLarge.en: The box is much larger than the part. Shrink the box to the outline of the part.

ui.noMatch.advice.sampleCoversMany.zh_TW: 樣本框到了不只一個元件：只框其中一個。要一次處理多個元件，請改用「區域掃描」（R）。
ui.noMatch.advice.sampleCoversMany.en: The box holds more than one part. Draw it around one part only. To handle many parts at once, use Scan region (R).

ui.noMatch.advice.sampleOffPart.zh_TW: 樣本沒有框到元件：把框移到一個元件上。
ui.noMatch.advice.sampleOffPart.en: The box is not on a part. Move the box onto one part.

ui.noMatch.advice.onlyOne.zh_TW: 板子上只有這一個相似的元件：改選一個有重複的元件當樣本。
ui.noMatch.advice.onlyOne.en: Only one such part exists on the board. Pick a part that repeats.

ui.noMatch.advice.lowContrast.zh_TW: 對比太低：元件與背景的差異不夠，換一個對比較高的元件當樣本。
ui.noMatch.advice.lowContrast.en: The contrast is too low. Pick a part that stands out more from the board.

ui.noMatch.advice.lowerThreshold.zh_TW: 分數門檻太高：目前最高分是 {best}，可降低到 {suggested} 再試。
ui.noMatch.advice.lowerThreshold.en: The score threshold is too high. The best score is {best}. Try {suggested}.

ui.error.imageOpen.body.zh_TW: 檔案 {name} 無法解碼。請確認檔案沒有損毀，或改用 PNG、BMP、JPEG。
ui.error.imageOpen.body.en: The file {name} cannot be decoded. Check that the file is not damaged, or use PNG, BMP or JPEG.

ui.error.backend.body.zh_TW: 找不到授權或程式庫。請改用 {fallback}，或檢查授權。
ui.error.backend.body.en: The license or the library is missing. Switch to {fallback}, or check the license.

ui.error.searchFailed.body.zh_TW: 後端回報錯誤：{detail}。樣本框已保留，可以再試一次。
ui.error.searchFailed.body.en: The back end reported an error: {detail}. The sample box stays. You can try again.

ui.backend.halcon.sdkDongleMissing.zh_TW: HALCON 用的是 runtime 授權（{inUse}）。開發用的 SDK 授權要插 dongle {missing}，目前沒有插上。
ui.backend.halcon.sdkDongleMissing.en: HALCON runs with the runtime license ({inUse}). The development (SDK) license needs the dongle {missing}, which is not attached.

ui.compare.entry.tip.zh_TW: 用兩個 back end 搜尋同一個樣本，疊在同一張影像上看差異。
ui.compare.entry.tip.en: Search the same sample with two back ends and see the differences on one image.

ui.compare.entry.needSample.zh_TW: 先教一個樣本（S），再比較兩個 back end。
ui.compare.entry.needSample.en: Teach a sample (S) first. Then compare two back ends.

ui.compare.entry.needTwo.zh_TW: 要有兩個能用的 back end 才能比較。
ui.compare.entry.needTwo.en: A comparison needs two usable back ends.

ui.compare.thresholds.note.zh_TW: 兩邊的分數不是同一把尺（OpenCV 是亮度的相關係數 NCC，HALCON 是邊緣方向的一致度），所以門檻分開設。改門檻只重新比較，不重新搜尋。
ui.compare.thresholds.note.en: The two scores do not use the same scale (OpenCV: intensity correlation, NCC; HALCON: agreement of edge directions). Each side has its own threshold. A threshold change compares again without a new search.

ui.compare.col.reason.en: Why the other side has none

ui.compare.differences.capped.zh_TW: 差異（{n}，列出前 {shown} 個；疊圖上全部都有）
ui.compare.differences.capped.en: Differences ({n}; the first {shown} are listed; the overlay shows all)

ui.compare.gap.belowThreshold.zh_TW: {backend} 的分數 {score} 低於它的門檻 {threshold}

ui.compare.gap.inferredOnly.zh_TW: {backend} 只是晶格推算（視窗內沒有找到）
ui.compare.gap.inferredOnly.en: {backend} only inferred a part here (the window check found none)

ui.compare.done.zh_TW: 完成：{a} {msA} ms、{b} {msB} ms（依序跑，耗時可以直接比）
ui.compare.done.en: Done: {a} {msA} ms, {b} {msB} ms (run one after the other, so the times compare directly)

ui.compare.notUsable.zh_TW: 這個 back end 在這個程式裡不能用。
ui.compare.notUsable.en: This back end is not usable in this program.

ui.compare.noSample.zh_TW: 沒有樣本可以比較：先在主視窗教一個樣本。
ui.compare.noSample.en: There is no sample to compare. Teach a sample in the main window first.

ui.compare.sameBackend.zh_TW: A 與 B 要選不同的 back end。
ui.compare.sameBackend.en: Choose two different back ends for A and B.

ui.scan.hint.zh_TW: 放開滑鼠，用樣本庫辨識區域內的元件 · Esc 取消
ui.scan.hint.en: Release to match the region with the library · Esc to cancel

ui.library.empty.zh_TW: 樣本庫還沒有樣本。先用「樣本」工具教一個。
ui.library.empty.en: The library has no sample yet. Teach one with the Sample tool.

ui.library.summary.zh_TW: {boxes} 個框 · 板子上的複本 {count} 個

ui.preview.unrecognized.zh_TW: 區域內還有 {count} 個元件沒有符合的樣本。
ui.preview.unrecognized.en: {count} more parts in the region match no library sample.

ui.noMatch.advice.libraryEmpty.zh_TW: 樣本庫是空的：先用「樣本」工具教一個樣本。
ui.noMatch.advice.libraryEmpty.en: The library is empty. Teach a sample first with the Sample tool.

ui.noMatch.advice.regionEmpty.zh_TW: 區域內沒有元件：把區域移到元件上，或拉大。
ui.noMatch.advice.regionEmpty.en: The region holds no part. Move the region onto parts, or make it larger.

ui.noMatch.advice.noLibraryMatch.zh_TW: 區域內有 {count} 個元件，但樣本庫沒有符合的樣本：教一個新樣本。
ui.noMatch.advice.noLibraryMatch.en: The region holds {count} parts, but no library sample matches. Teach a new sample.

ui.editor.affects.zh_TW: 儲存後，板上 {count} 個 {partNo} 元件會一起更新。
ui.editor.affects.en: After you save, {count} {partNo} components on the board update together.

ui.editor.partNoTaken.zh_TW: 料號 {partNo} 已在樣本庫中。
ui.editor.partNoTaken.en: The part number {partNo} is already in the library.

ui.editor.needBox.en: The type needs at least one box.

ui.editor.hint.zh_TW: B 畫框 · 改列數／欄數即可一次建立矩陣 · Del 刪除 · Esc 取消
ui.editor.hint.en: B draws a box · set rows and columns to make a matrix at once · Del deletes · Esc cancels

ui.editor.selectHint.en: Select a box group to edit it.

ui.toast.typeSaved.zh_TW: 已儲存 {partNo}：更新 {count} 個元件

ui.editor.scope.kind.zh_TW: 此類型中所有相同種類的框
ui.editor.scope.kind.en: All boxes of the same kind in this type

ui.editor.bodyOnce.zh_TW: 每個元件只能有一個主體框。
ui.editor.bodyOnce.en: A component can have only one body box.

ui.editor.bodyKeep.zh_TW: 主體框不能刪除；先刪掉依附它的框，或改它的大小。
ui.editor.bodyKeep.en: You cannot delete the body box. Resize it instead.

ui.editor.needParent.zh_TW: 先選一個主體或 Pin 群組，當作檢測窗的父框。
ui.editor.needParent.en: Select a body or a pin group first. It becomes the parent of the window.

ui.editor.addedAll.zh_TW: 已產生 {count} 組標準檢測窗。

ui.editor.noBody.en: Draw the body box first (B). Then draw the pins.

ui.library.filter.en: Filter by part number, name or alias

ui.library.localOnly.zh_TW: 這個類型只在這塊板子上，還沒存入樣本庫。
ui.library.localOnly.en: This type exists on this board only. It is not in the library yet.

ui.cad.note.zh_TW: 5 個欄位：元件名稱、X、Y、角度、元件形式（再加正反面）。原型的座標單位是影像像素，原點在影像左上角；真正的匯出由 S12 實作，會轉成物理單位與 CAD 原點。
ui.cad.note.en: Five fields: name, X, Y, angle and type, plus the side. The prototype uses image pixels with the origin at the top left. The real export in S12 converts to physical units and a CAD origin.

ui.cad.empty.zh_TW: 板上還沒有元件。先接受一份提案。
ui.cad.empty.en: The board has no component yet. Accept a proposal first.

ui.sel.none.zh_TW: 在畫布或物件樹選一個元件。
ui.sel.none.en: Select a component on the canvas or in the tree.

ui.noMatch.advice.alreadyOnBoard.zh_TW: 區域內的元件都已經在板上了。
ui.noMatch.advice.alreadyOnBoard.en: All parts in the region are on the board already.

ui.editor.saveBoth.en: Save and add to the library

ui.editor.affectsLib.zh_TW: 這是樣本庫的條目。板子上已有的複本不會自動更新（目前 {count} 個複本）。
ui.editor.affectsLib.en: This is a library entry. Copies on boards do not update by themselves ({count} copies now).

ui.sel.localType.zh_TW: 這個類型只在這塊板子上，還沒存入樣本庫。
ui.sel.localType.en: This type exists on this board only. It is not in the library yet.

ui.toast.pulled.zh_TW: 已從樣本庫更新 {partNo}：更新 {count} 個元件
ui.toast.pulled.en: Updated {partNo} from the library. Updated {count} components.

ui.toast.libSaved.zh_TW: 已儲存到樣本庫：{partNo}（板子上的複本不會自動更新）
ui.toast.libSaved.en: Saved {partNo} to the library. Copies on boards do not update by themselves.

ui.add.needType.zh_TW: 板子上還沒有元件類型：先接受一份提案。
ui.add.needType.en: The board has no component type yet. Accept a proposal first.

ui.params.scope.auto.zh_TW: 先用板子已有的類型，找不到再擴大（建議）
ui.params.scope.auto.en: Board types first, then the whole library (proposed)

ui.params.bits.rejected.zh_TW: 影像裡有超過 {requested} bit 的值，維持 {bits} bit。
ui.params.bits.rejected.en: The image has values above {requested}-bit. It stays {bits}-bit.

ui.noMatch.advice.scopeBoard.zh_TW: 區域內有 {count} 個元件，在整個樣本庫裡可能有符合的樣本，但目前只比對板子已有的類型。
ui.noMatch.advice.scopeBoard.en: The region holds {count} parts that may match a library sample. The scope is board types only.

ui.preview.outOfScope.zh_TW: {count} 個元件在整個樣本庫裡可能有符合的樣本（目前只比對板子已有的類型）。
ui.preview.outOfScope.en: {count} more parts may match a library sample. The scope is board types only.

ui.editor.unavailable.en: The type editor is not available yet.

ui.selection.applyToAll.tip.zh_TW: 把這個寬 × 高套到板子上每一個樣本的類型（一個步驟，可以復原）
ui.selection.applyToAll.tip.en: Set every sample type on the board to this width × height (one step, can be undone)

ui.selection.previewOnlyMove.zh_TW: 預覽中只能改位置；要改大小，先接受或捨棄提案。
ui.selection.previewOnlyMove.en: In preview you can only move it. Accept or discard the proposal to resize.

ui.selection.position.lattice.zh_TW: 陣列的格點（匹配位置偏差 {deviation} px）

ui.selection.position.member.zh_TW: 匹配位置（離陣列的格點 {deviation} px）
ui.selection.position.member.en: Match ({deviation} px from its array node)

ui.selection.position.matched.zh_TW: 匹配位置（離最近格點 {deviation} px，偏離陣列）
ui.selection.position.matched.en: Match ({deviation} px from the nearest node, off the array)

ui.selection.position.noLattice.zh_TW: 匹配位置（不在任何陣列）

ui.params.position.lattice.zh_TW: 吸附到陣列（CAD 理論位置）

ui.params.position.tip.zh_TW: 同一個陣列的元件放在規律的格子上（間距一致、行列對齊），不在陣列裡的保留匹配位置；切換只重新分類，不重新搜尋
ui.params.position.tip.en: Parts of one array sit on a regular grid (equal pitch, aligned rows). Parts outside an array keep their matched position. Switching only reclassifies; it does not search again

ui.resize.appliedAll.zh_TW: 已把 {w} × {h} px 套到 {count} 個樣本的類型 · Ctrl+Z 復原
ui.resize.appliedAll.en: {w} × {h} px applied to {count} sample types · Ctrl+Z to undo

ui.resize.nothingToApply.zh_TW: 所有樣本已經是這個大小。
ui.resize.nothingToApply.en: Every sample already has this size.

ui.history.resizeTypes.zh_TW: 把 {count} 個類型的框設成同樣大小
ui.history.resizeTypes.en: Set the boxes of {count} types to one size

ui.library.boardSamples.zh_TW: 板子上的 {count} 個樣本 · 點一筆在畫布上選取它
ui.library.boardSamples.en: {count} samples on the board · click one to select it on the canvas

ui.library.sample.tip.en: Click to select {name} on the canvas
